QuestInfo.name: Following the Pirate
QuestInfo.0: Kyrin's story leave you much to ponder. Who's Tess and where might you find him? Head back to the Six Path Crossway. That hasn't failed you yet!
QuestInfo.1: You found the guy Kyrin was talking about at the Six Path Crossway. He's heading for the Nautilus. Follow him!
QuestInfo.2: You follow Tess, the suspicious pirate Kyrin wanted you to keep an eye on, and find him confronting a... rabbit?

1.0: Don't just stand there! Help me! \r\nWait a second. Is that you, #bKao#k?!
